t: Regulating Act 1773: Established the first Supreme Court at Fort William, Calcutta (1774). First Chief Justice: Sir Elijah Impey.
Charter Act 1813: First time provision made for spending at least ₹1 lakh per year on education of Indians; ended Company’s trade monopoly in India (except tea & China).

Charter Act 1833: Made Governor-General of Bengal the first Governor-General of India (Lord William Bentinck). First Law Member of Governor-General’s Council: Macaulay. Section 87 first opened Company service to Indians without discrimination of religion, colour, etc.
Charter Act 1853: First time separated legislative & executive functions of Governor-General’s Council; introduced open competition for Civil Services.
Government of India Act 1858: Lord Canning became the first Viceroy of India.

Indian Councils Act 1909 (Morley-Minto): First time Indians associated with Viceroy’s & Governors’ Executive Councils. Satyendra Prasad Sinha became the first Indian Law Member of Viceroy’s Executive Council. Introduced separate electorate for Muslims (Lord Minto called “Father of Communal Electorate”).
Government of India Act 1919 (Montagu-Chelmsford): First time introduced direct elections.
Government of India Act 1919 (Montagu-Chelmsford): First time made Central Legislature bicameral.
Government of India Act 1919 (Montagu-Chelmsford): First time introduced dyarchy in provinces.
Government of India Act 1919 (Montagu-Chelmsford): First time used the term “responsible government”.
Government of India Act 1935: First time provided for an All-India Federation (never came into existence).
Government of India Act 1935: Introduced dyarchy at the Centre (never implemented) and abolished it in provinces.
Government of India Act 1935: Established Federal Court (inaugurated 1 Oct 1937; first Chief Justice: Sir Maurice Gwyer).
Government of India Act 1935: Separated Burma from India; created Sindh & Orissa as new provinces.
Government of India Act 1935: Residuary powers vested in Governor-General.
